summary: Run 3 of M1-S04 — a § 4 test-only repair after reports/MOCK-DEPLOY-M1.md run 6 (S2-F-11), the same finding that sent M1-S03 back to running: Tier2ChannelHealthQueueable's three aggregate COUNT() queries enforce the running user's FLS by default under API 67.0, and Tier2ChannelHealthTest had no System.runAs block for a permissioned user — every method ran as the deploying user. Tier2ChannelHealthSchedulable.cls and Tier2ChannelHealthQueueable.cls are untouched. templates/apex/tests/TestUserFactory.cls is NOT re-shipped here — it already ships in M1-S03's artefacts (that step's own S2-F-11 repair), and this step depends on that copy instead, recorded in deploy-order.md § 0c/§ 2 since plan.json's depends_on could not be amended (step past pending). Tier2ChannelHealthTest gained PERM_SET/PROFILE constants, a new mixed-DML setup-object fence in @TestSetup around TestUserFactory.createUser (this class had no pre-existing setup-object fence to fold into, unlike M1-S03), a re-queried agent() helper, and every one of its 11 @IsTest method bodies wrapped in System.runAs(testUser) — same statements, same assertions, same messages, same order; verified with a whitespace-insensitive diff against the pre-repair file showing only inserted lines, zero removed. check_test_class_standards.py --manifest-dir artefacts/M1-S04 now reports ERROR=0 (rule user-mode-test-without-runas, the repair's target, fires zero times, down from ERROR=1 confirmed against the pre-repair file in isolation) and WARN=1 (template-class-not-shipped, naming TestUserFactory — expected, since it is deliberately not shipped in this step's own manifest directory). The three previously-declared checkers were re-run unchanged and still exit 0; check-outputs is ok on all six declared paths.
confidence_rationale: MEDIUM per GATES.md Gate D: Gate B resolved every symbol this run touches (TestUserFactory.createUser, Profile/PermissionSet/PermissionSetAssignment fields, all copied from the template or standard-object grounding) and Gate C check 3 (compile) did not run — build_mode is design-only, there is no target_org_alias, and there is no offline Apex compiler in the sf CLI. The fix is a mechanical application of a documented pattern (Example 5, and M1-S03's own already-accepted repair) the checker itself now verifies at ERROR=0. What would raise this to HIGH is a green dry run with --test-level RunSpecifiedTests or RunLocalTests, which no agent in this loop may perform.

findings.title: Two of eleven wrapped methods carry an unresolved PermissionSetAssignment/system-object access question
findings.detail: Tier2_Webhook_Admin (confirmed via M1-S02's permission set XML) grants object/field permissions only on Integration_Failure__c and Case.Tier2_Notified_At__c — nothing on PermissionSetAssignment, CronTrigger or AsyncApexJob. rosterResolutionReturnsTheDistinctActiveAssigneeEmails queries PermissionSetAssignment directly, and scheduleCreatesAWaitingCronTriggerAndDispatchesTheQueueable calls System.schedule and queries CronTrigger/AsyncApexJob — both now run as the Standard-User-profile permissioned agent under API 67.0's default user mode. Whether that profile can read those objects or schedule Apex is stated in no cited skill. This mirrors the same open question deploy-order.md § 4 item 1 already raises for the production running user; resolving it means changing Tier2_Webhook_Admin, which belongs to M1-S02, out of scope for a test-only repair.
findings.recommendation: Confirm at the M1 gate whether the scheduling user's actual profile (not necessarily Standard User) can read PermissionSetAssignment/CronTrigger/AsyncApexJob; if not, both the production roster-resolution path and this test method degrade the same way.

findings.title: PROFILE = 'Standard User' is a default, not a grounded fact (second instance in this build)
findings.detail: No clarification in this build names a Profile for the users who hold Tier2_Webhook_Admin. 'Standard User' is used because it is a real standard Salesforce profile present in every org and is the same value M1-S03's already-accepted repair used for the identical pattern.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the actual profile(s) assigned Tier2_Webhook_Admin and update PROFILE if it differs. Does not block this repair.
